message.abstract: <jats:title>A<jats:sc>bstract</jats:sc></jats:title><jats:p>In this short note, we present some evidence towards the existence of an algebra of BPS<jats:italic>G</jats:italic><jats:sub>2</jats:sub>instantons. These are instantonic configurations that govern the partition functions of 7d SYM theories on local<jats:italic>G</jats:italic><jats:sub>2</jats:sub>holonomy manifolds<jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:tex-math>$$ \mathcal{X} $$</jats:tex-math><mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mml:mi>X</mml:mi></mml:math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula>. To shed light on such structure, we begin investigating the relation with parent 4d<jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:tex-math>$$ \mathcal{N} $$</jats:tex-math><mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mml:mi>N</mml:mi></mml:math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula>= 1 theories obtained by geometric engineering M-theory on<jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:tex-math>$$ \mathcal{X} $$</jats:tex-math><mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mml:mi>X</mml:mi></mml:math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula>. The main point of this paper is to substantiate the following dream: the holomorphic sector of such theories on multi-centered Taub-NUT spaces gives rise to an algebra whose characters organise the<jats:italic>G</jats:italic><jats:sub>2</jats:sub>instanton partition function. As a first step towards this program we argue by string duality that a multitude of geometries<jats:inline-formula><jats:alternatives><jats:tex-math>$$ \mathcal{X} $$</jats:tex-math><mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mml:mi>X</mml:mi></mml:math></jats:alternatives></jats:inline-formula>exist that are dual to well-known 4d SCFTs arising from D3 branes probes of CY cones: all these models are amenable to an analysis along the lines suggested by Dijkgraaf, Gukov, Neitzke and Vafa in the context of topological M-theory. Moreover, we discuss an interesting relation to Costello’s twisted M-theory, which arises at local patches, and is a key ingredient in identifying the relevant algebras.</jats:p>
title: Evidence for an algebra of G2 instantons
